title: Geminivirus Betasatellite-Encoded betaC1 Protein Exhibits Novel ATP Hydrolysis Activity That Influences Its DNA-Binding Activity and Viral Pathogenesis.
authors: Gnanasekaran, Prabu; Gupta, Neha; Ponnusamy, Kalaiarasan; Chakraborty, Supriya
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双生病毒卫星蛋白betaC1的ATP酶活性及其对DNA结合活性的影响，涉及蛋白-DNA互作与分子对接，但对象非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以生化实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Plant virus satellites are maintained by their associated helper viruses, and satellites influence viral pathogenesis. Diseases caused by geminivirus-betasatellite complexes can become epidemics and therefore have become a threat to economically important crops across the world. Here, we identified a novel molecular function of the betasatellite-encoded pathogenicity determinant betaC1. The tomato leaf curl Patna betasatellite (ToLCPaB)-encoded betaC1 protein was found to exhibit novel ATPase activity in the presence of the divalent metal ion cofactor MgCl(2). Moreover, ATPase activity was confirmed to be ubiquitously displayed by betaC1 proteins encoded by diverse betasatellites. Mutational and sequence analysis showed that conserved lysine/arginine residues at positions 49/50 and 91 of betaC1 proteins are essential for their ATPase activity. Biochemical studies revealed that the DNA-binding activity of the betaC1 protein was interfered with by the binding of ATP to the protein. Mutating arginine 91 of betaC1 to alanine reduced its DNA-binding activity. The results of docking studies provided evidence for an overlap of the ATP-binding and DNA-binding regions of betaC1 and for the importance of arginine 91 for both ATP-binding and DNA-binding activities. A mutant betasatellite with a specifically betaC1-ATPase dominant negative mutation was found to induce symptoms on Nicotiana benthamiana plants similar to those induced by wild-type betasatellite infection. The ATPase function of betaC1 was found to be negatively associated with geminivirus-betasatellite DNA accumulation, despite the positive influence of this ATPase function on the accumulation of replication-associated protein (Rep) and betaC1 transcripts. IMPORTANCE Most satellites influence the pathogenesis of their helper viruses. Here, we characterized the novel molecular function of betaC1, a nonstructural pathogenicity determinant protein encoded by a betasatellite. We demonstrated the display of ATPase activity by this betaC1 protein. Additionally, we confirmed the ubiquitous display of ATPase activity by betaC1 proteins encoded by diverse betasatellites. The lysine/arginine residues conserved at positions 49 and 91 of betaC1 were found to be crucial for its ATPase function. DNA-binding activity of betaC1 was found to be reduced in the presence of ATP. Inhibition of ATPase activity of betaC1 in the presence of an excess concentration of cold ATP, GTP, CTP, or UTP suggested that the purified betaC1 can also hydrolyze other cellular nucleoside triphosphates (NTPs) besides ATP in vitro. These results established the importance of the ATPase and DNA-binding activities of the betaC1 protein in regulating geminivirus-betasatellite DNA accumulation in the infected plant cell.
abstract_zh: 植物病毒卫星体由其辅助病毒维持，且卫星体影响病毒致病性。由双生病毒-β卫星复合体引起的病害可成为流行病，因此对全球重要经济作物构成威胁。在此，我们鉴定了β卫星编码的致病性决定因子betaC1的一种新型分子功能。发现番茄卷叶巴特那β卫星（ToLCPaB）编码的betaC1蛋白在二价金属离子辅因子MgCl(2)存在下表现出新型ATP酶活性。此外，ATP酶活性被证实普遍存在于由多种β卫星编码的betaC1蛋白中。突变和序列分析表明，betaC1蛋白第49/50位和第91位保守的赖氨酸/精氨酸残基对其ATP酶活性至关重要。生化研究表明，ATP与betaC1蛋白的结合干扰了该蛋白的DNA结合活性。将betaC1的第91位精氨酸突变为丙氨酸降低了其DNA结合活性。对接研究结果提供了证据，表明betaC1的ATP结合区域和DNA结合区域存在重叠，且第91位精氨酸对ATP结合和DNA结合活性均至关重要。一个具有特异性betaC1-ATP酶显性负突变的突变β卫星在本氏烟（Nicotiana benthamiana）植物上诱导的症状与野生型β卫星感染诱导的症状相似。发现betaC1的ATP酶功能与双生病毒-β卫星DNA积累呈负相关，尽管该ATP酶功能对复制相关蛋白（Rep）和betaC1转录本的积累有正向影响。重要性 大多数卫星体影响其辅助病毒的致病性。在此，我们表征了betaC1（一种由β卫星编码的非结构致病性决定因子蛋白）的新型分子功能。我们证明了该betaC1蛋白表现出ATP酶活性。此外，我们确认了由多种β卫星编码的betaC1蛋白普遍表现出ATP酶活性。发现betaC1第49位和第91位保守的赖氨酸/精氨酸残基对其ATP酶功能至关重要。在ATP存在下，betaC1的DNA结合活性降低。在过量冷ATP、GTP、CTP或UTP存在下抑制betaC1的ATP酶活性，表明纯化的betaC1在体外除ATP外还可水解其他细胞核苷三磷酸（NTPs）。这些结果确立了betaC1蛋白的ATP酶和DNA结合活性在调节感染植物细胞中双生病毒-β卫星DNA积累方面的重要性。
